/* Upd_run_start : 수집 이력 PENDING -> RUNNING (start_dt 기록). ingest_pipeline_run_id 에는 마스터 RunId 기록 (Child 파이프라인 없음) */

UPDATE adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
SET
    ingest_pipeline_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}',
    status                 = 'RUNNING',
    start_dt               = NOW(),
    attempt_no             = attempt_no + 1,
    update_by              = 'ADF',
    update_dt              = NOW()
WHERE master_run_id       = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}'
  AND ingest_pipeline_id  = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_ingest_pipeline_id}';
   AND status = 'PENDING';

/* Upd_run_ok : Copy 성공 -> SUCCEEDED. 건수 = rowsRead / rowsCopied, 크기(MB) = dataRead / dataWritten (byte / 1048576) */
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
   SET status       = 'SUCCEEDED',
       end_dt       = now(),
       extract_cnt  = @{activity('Copy data').output.rowsRead},
       save_cnt     = @{activity('Copy data').output.rowsCopied},
       read_size_mb = round(@{activity('Copy data').output.dataRead}::numeric / 1048576, 2),
       file_size_mb = round(@{activity('Copy data').output.dataWritten}::numeric / 1048576, 2),
       updated_by   = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt   = now()
 WHERE 
  master_run_id      = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}'
  AND ingest_pipeline_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_ingest_pipeline_id}';
  AND status = 'RUNNING';
